--- HOME PAGE ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/

Title: Elysium λ Development & Research
Hero: Digital Infrastructure for SMEs: No Development Costs

Description:
Subscription-based digital infrastructure for SMEs: cloud systems, bespoke CRM,
cybersecurity and applied R&D in the EU and Costa Rica, with no development cost.

ORGANISATION PROFILE:
Elysium λ Development & Research is a European digital-infrastructure company
and an independent software-engineering, IT-consulting, and R&D laboratory.
It was founded in January 2026, is established in Portugal, and operates in
Costa Rica. It serves SMEs across the European Union and Costa Rica.

OPERATING MODEL:
Digital infrastructure is included in a monthly subscription. Elysium assumes
the initial development cost so that each client's website, cloud infrastructure,
management software, and security can evolve with the business.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

1. Ergonomic interfaces adapted to human behaviour
   - Responsive platforms designed to feel immediate.
   - Complex activities, such as appointments and long forms, are converted
     into simple workflows to reduce cognitive fatigue and human error.
   - Interfaces remain readable and functional on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

2. Cloud digital infrastructure and databases
   - Cloud infrastructure scales with traffic and is designed for high availability.
   - Data changes are synchronised immediately across authorised team members.
   - Third-party services such as payment gateways and corporate calendars can
     be integrated into the ecosystem.

3. Bespoke management systems (CRM)
   - Software is built around the rules of the project, including functions such
     as financial management or billing.
   - Repetitive daily processes can be automated.
   - Business data is centralised in one accessible dashboard for authorised staff.

4. Cybersecurity and governance
   - High-level security and encryption standards protect data.
   - Strict access control limits each person to the information they need.
   - Infrastructure is designed for compliance with the GDPR, Costa Rica's Law
     No. 8968, and applicable local privacy rules.

SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS SHOWN ON THE HOMEPAGE:
- Presence: EUR 70/month or EUR 700/year.
- System: EUR 99/month or EUR 990/year.
- Operations: EUR 120/month or EUR 1,200/year.
- Independent Hosting Maintenance: EUR 99/year.
Annual billing is the equivalent of two months free.
See https://elysiumdr.eu/services for the complete scope and conditions.
λ DEVELOPMENT FRAMEWORK — SCIENTIFIC METHODOLOGY:
1. Current Operational Environment — analyse data flows, daily processes, and
   the client's industry context.
2. State of the Art and Limitations — document the technological infrastructure
   the company already uses.
3. Critical Variables — identify manual processes, data-management issues, and
   structural vulnerabilities.
4. Problem Definition — define the core problem the new infrastructure must solve.
5. Impact — target risk mitigation, reduced downtime, and greater digital presence.
6. Architecture — propose the appropriate ecosystem, such as SaaS, a bespoke CRM,
   or a redesign of the existing site.
7. Technology Selection — select security protocols, databases, and integrations.
8. Design, Development, and Database — build the project's digital ecosystem.
9. QA and Audit — test the system, validate access controls, and audit compliance
   with the GDPR and Costa Rica's Law No. 8968.
10. Handover and Training — launch the system, synchronise final data, and train
    the client's team.

RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT:
Elysium λ operates as an independent software-engineering and IT-consulting
laboratory in the European Union and Costa Rica. It combines scientific thinking,
ergonomic design, and continuous experimentation to solve structural inefficiencies
and make high-level engineering accessible to SMEs.

Mission statement: Democratise access to digital infrastructure by giving SMEs
accessible technological ecosystems that automate their processes and support
their scalability.

TEAM AND CURRENT SOCIAL PROOF:
- Developer: Daniel Alonso Morales Ávila, Founder & Computer Science Engineer.
- Featured partner review: Paulo Morais, founder of Consciênciavaliativa —
  Unipessoal Lda, describes improved communication, visibility, and client
  acquisition after the website project. Full review:
  https://elysiumdr.eu/review-pmorais

--- SERVICES PAGE ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/services

Title: Services — Elysium λ Development & Research
Description: Zero Development Costs: High-performance digital infrastructure included in your monthly subscription.

ENTERPRISE-GRADE DIGITAL INFRASTRUCTURE

Zero Development Cost Model:
High-performance digital infrastructure included in monthly subscription.
You don't pay for website construction — each monthly fee is an investment in
an ecosystem that evolves with your business, guaranteeing peak performance,
operational security, and high lead retention.

SUBSCRIPTION TIERS:

1. Hosting — €99/year (infrastructure only)
   - Domain management and brand digital identity.
   - Web hosting on high-availability servers (always online).
   - Base infrastructure maintenance and updates.
   - Website development is not included.

2. Presence — €70/month or €700/year
   - Website, domain, email and hosting.
   - Online booking with automatic reminders, which is what removes no-shows.
   - Client records.
   - GDPR compliance and legal notices kept current.
   - One hour of changes per month.

3. System — €99/month or €990/year
   - Everything in Presence.
   - Private client area where each client logs in and sees their own history.
   - Administrator CRM.
   - Availability and cancellation management.
   - Up to 3 professionals. Two hours of changes per month.

4. Operations — €120/month or €1,200/year
   - Everything in System.
   - Online payments and session packs with running balances.
   - Occupancy and no-show reporting.
   - Custom-built software that scales alongside the business.
   - Unlimited professionals. Four hours of changes per month.

TRANSPARENCY & LICENSING:
- Zero Development Cost: Elysium assumes 100% of initial engineering.
- Code Ownership (IP): Source code remains intellectual property of Elysium λ.
  Clients acquire a full-use licence tied to their active subscription.
- Lifecycle & Continuity: If subscription is interrupted, system and support
  will be suspended.
- Valuation & Buyout: If your business model requires total code ownership,
  we offer an auditing and valuation process for project buyout.

--- ABOUT PAGE ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/about

Title: Our Ethos — Elysium λ Development & Research
Description: Mission, vision, R&D ethos, and story of Elysium λ Development &
Research, a European digital-infrastructure company established in Portugal and
operating in Costa Rica.

ETHOS:
"Our work is guided by the conviction that digital infrastructure should be
accessible, transparent, and focused on R&D."

MISSION:
Democratise access to digital infrastructure by providing SMEs with accessible
technological ecosystems that automate their processes and ensure scalability.
The mission is to give small and medium-sized enterprises infrastructure that
evolves with their businesses.

VISION:
To become the Elysium λ Institute of Development & Research, dedicated to the
study, development, and application of digital infrastructures and to training
new generations of scientists and developers. Elysium λ aims to contribute to
a digital European Union and a Costa Rica advancing towards modernity.

OUR STORY:
Elysium λ was founded to work alongside SMEs, strengthen their digital presence,
and give them infrastructure that enables them to scale. SMEs are a structural
backbone of both the European Union and Costa Rican economies, but many remain
excluded from technological transformation by cost, complexity, and digital-
literacy barriers. Elysium λ investigates and develops infrastructure intended
to make advanced technology more accessible, transparent, and trustworthy.

MEANING OF THE NAME:
- Elysium comes from the ancient Greek Ἠλύσιον, associated with justice, harmony,
  and brotherhood. The name also evokes Friedrich Schiller's 1785 poem
  "An die Freude" (Ode to Joy), incorporated by Ludwig van Beethoven into the
  fourth movement of his Ninth Symphony; its instrumental setting is the anthem
  of the European Union.
- λ (lambda) is the eleventh Greek letter and the second letter of Ἠλύσιον.
  For this project, it represents the abstraction of ideas into executable systems.
- Together, Elysium λ expresses the aspiration to contribute to an increasingly
  unified European Union.

CURRENT DIRECTION AND LOCATION:
Beginning with digital infrastructure for SMEs, Elysium λ intends to grow into
research and the training of scientific developers for a European and Costa Rican
digital future focused on R&D. It is a European company established in Portugal,
with operations in Costa Rica, serving SMEs across the European Union and Costa Rica.

CERTIFICATION AUTHORITIES AND INSTITUTIONAL PARTNERS DISPLAYED:
ULACIT; Universidad Nacional de Costa Rica (UNA); Instituto Politécnico de
Bragança (IPB); Autoridade Tributária; Made in EU; Livro de Reclamações; Google.

Specific deliverables, deadlines, and pricing are governed by individual service agreements or project proposals issued separately.

3. Right of Withdrawal — Cooling-Off Period (EU)

In accordance with Directive 2011/83/EU on consumer rights, consumers who are residents of the European Union have the right to withdraw from a distance contract within 14 calendar days from the date the contract is concluded, without providing any reason.

To exercise this right, notify us in writing at info@elysiumdr.eu before the 14-day period expires. This right does not apply to services that have been fully performed with your prior express consent, or to custom digital content delivered and accepted by you.

4. Data Protection & Privacy

The processing of your personal data is governed by our Privacy Policy, which is incorporated by reference into these Terms. We comply with:

                    - GDPR (EU 2016/679) — for users residing in the European Union and European Economic Area.

                    - Law No. 8968 (Costa Rica) — Ley de Protección de la Persona frente al Tratamiento de sus Datos Personales, supervised by PRODHAB.

                    - Law No. 58/2019 (Portugal) — domestic implementation of the GDPR.

Sensitive data (including health-related information, where applicable) will only be processed upon obtaining your explicit, documented consent as required by Art. 9 GDPR and Art. 9 of Law 8968.

5. Intellectual Property

All content, code, designs, and materials produced by Elysium λ Development & Research and published on this website remain the exclusive intellectual property of the company unless explicitly transferred in writing via a client agreement. Temporary access to materials for personal, non-commercial viewing is granted under these Terms but does not constitute assignment of any intellectual property rights.

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Elysium λ Development & Research shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of this website or our services. Our maximum aggregate liability is limited to the amounts paid by you for the specific service giving rise to the claim in the 12 months preceding the event.

7. Tax Obligations

Fees quoted by Elysium λ Development & Research are exclusive of applicable taxes unless otherwise stated. For clients in Portugal, services are subject to the applicable VAT rate under CIVA (Código do IVA). Certain health-related professional services may qualify for VAT exemption under Art. 9 CIVA where legally applicable. Tax invoices will be issued according to Portuguese fiscal law.

8. Dispute Resolution

https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr

These Terms are governed by the laws of Portugal and the European Union. In the absence of amicable resolution, disputes shall be submitted to the competent courts of Bragança, Portugal, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer protection provisions applicable in the user's country of residence.

--- PRIVACY POLICY ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/privacy

λ

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: July 2026

1. Identity and Contact Information of the Data Controller

The data controller for your personal information is:

                    - Full Legal Name: Elysium λ Development & Research

                    - Legal Representative: Daniel Alonso Morales Ávila

                    - NIF / VAT: 321979257PT

                    - Registered Address: Bragança, Portugal, European Union

                    - Email for Privacy Enquiries: info@elysiumdr.eu

2. Information We Collect and Purpose

We only collect personal information that you provide voluntarily through our digital channels:

                    - Contact & Onboarding Forms: Full name, professional email address, company name, website, and project-specific details.

                    - Purpose: To manage your inquiries, provide requested technical information, and execute pre-contractual or contractual measures necessary to initiate our professional services.

3. Sensitive Data — Health Information (Art. 9 GDPR / Art. 9 Law 8968)

Where our services involve health-related or clinically sensitive data (e.g., physical assessments, medical history), this constitutes special category data under Art. 9 of the GDPR (EU 2016/679) and sensitive personal data under Art. 9 of Costa Rica's Law No. 8968.

Such data will only be processed upon your explicit, documented consent (recorded as consentHealthData: true in our system). You may withdraw this consent at any time. Processing without consent is strictly prohibited.

4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your data based on the following legal foundations:

                    - Explicit Consent: When you voluntarily complete our forms and check the explicit acceptance box, or specifically authorise health data processing.

                    - Pre-contractual measures: When your request involves the preparation of a budget, quote, or technical assessment.

                    - Legitimate Interest: To maintain the security, integrity, and optimal functioning of our internal systems and digital delivery infrastructure.

                    - Legal Obligation: To comply with applicable fiscal, regulatory, and security obligations in Portugal (EU) and Costa Rica.

5. Data Retention & Automated Purging

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or to comply with applicable legal, tax, or regulatory obligations. Our automated retention policy operates as follows:

                    - Health & clinical data: Anonymised after 5 years of inactivity.

                    - Fiscal & user profile data: Fully anonymised and purged from authentication systems after 10 years of inactivity, in line with European fiscal obligations and Costa Rica's Law 8968.

Automated purging is executed via scheduled backend tasks to ensure compliance without manual intervention.

6. Your Comprehensive Rights

Consistent with the GDPR (EU), Law No. 58/2019 (Portugal), and Law No. 8968 (Costa Rica / PRODHAB), you possess the following rights which may be exercised free of charge:

                    - Access: To obtain confirmation on whether your data is being processed and access it.

                    - Rectification: To correct inaccurate or incomplete data.

                    - Erasure (Right to be Forgotten): To request the deletion of data when it is no longer necessary.

                    - Restriction of Processing: To limit how your data is used under specific circumstances.

                    - Data Portability: To receive your data in a structured, electronic format.

                    - Objection: To oppose processing for specific reasons or marketing purposes.

                    - Withdrawal of Consent: You may withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.

To exercise these rights, please send an explicit request to info@elysiumdr.eu.

7. Recipients and Third Parties

We do not sell or trade your data. We share information only with essential service providers who act as processors under our strict instructions:

                    - Hosting & Backend: Firebase (Google Cloud), with servers primarily in the EU.

                    - Communication: Corporate email and secure CRM systems used strictly for project management.

8. International Data Transfers

When using global infrastructure like Google Cloud, data may occasionally be transferred to regions outside the European Economic Area (EEA). We ensure these transfers are covered by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission (Art. 46 GDPR), guaranteeing a level of protection equivalent to the GDPR.

For Costa Rica users, cross-border transfers comply with Law No. 8968, which requires that recipient systems guarantee adequate levels of security and confidentiality — a condition met by Google Cloud's internationally certified infrastructure.

9. Technical Security Measures

We implement robust technical and organisational security measures, including:

                    - HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security): Forces exclusive HTTPS connections for one year, protecting against man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks.

                    - Content Security Policy (CSP) Level 3: Strict directives blocking unauthorised script and style injection (XSS).

                    - X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors: Mitigates Clickjacking attacks.

                    - Permissions-Policy: Restricts browser access to camera, microphone, and geolocation.

                    - HMAC-SHA256 Cryptographic Signing: Used for token integrity verification, preventing tampering.

                    - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Enforced at database level via Firestore security rules — only authenticated data owners can access their own records.

                    - User Enumeration Protection: Sensitive endpoints return generic responses to prevent user account discovery.

                    - Constant-Time Comparison: Token verification uses timing-safe equality to prevent timing-based information leakage.

                    - Secret Manager: All credentials and cryptographic secrets are stored in Google Cloud Secret Manager — never in source code.

10. Infrastructure Certifications

Our platform is hosted on Google Cloud / Firebase infrastructure. Although Elysium λ Development & Research does not hold private audit certifications (standard for independent professional businesses), our platform inherits the following Google Cloud certifications:

                    - ISO/IEC 27001, 27017, 27018 — Information Security Management and Cloud Security.

                    - SOC 1, SOC 2, SOC 3 — System and Organisation Controls.

                    - PCI-DSS compatibility and HIPAA-eligible services (de facto reference standard for private clinics in Costa Rica selecting cloud providers).

11. Cookies and Tracking

Our website utilises only essential and technical cookies required for navigation and basic security. We do not employ third-party tracking, profiling, or behavioral advertising cookies without your explicit, opt-in consent, in compliance with the ePrivacy Directive (2002/58/EC) and the principles of Law No. 8968 (Costa Rica).

12. Mandatory Nature of Information

Fields marked with an asterisk (*) in our forms are strictly mandatory to process your request. Failure to provide this minimum information will prevent us from establishing contact or delivering the requested services.

13. Right to Lodge a Complaint

If you believe your data has been handled improperly, you have the right to claim before the competent supervisory authorities:

                    - Portugal (EU): Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD) — www.cnpd.pt

                    - Costa Rica: Agencia de Protección de Datos de los Habitantes (PRODHAB) — www.prodhab.go.cr

--- PÁGINA DE INICIO ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/es/

Título: Elysium λ Development & Research
Titular: Infraestructura Digital para pymes: Sin Costes de Desarrollo

Descripción:
Infraestructura digital por suscripción para pymes: sistemas cloud, CRM a medida,
ciberseguridad e I+D aplicada en la UE y Costa Rica, sin costes de desarrollo.

PERFIL DE LA ORGANIZACIÓN:
Elysium λ Development & Research es una empresa europea de infraestructura
digital y un laboratorio independiente de ingeniería de software, consultoría
informática e I+D. Fue fundada en enero de 2026, está establecida en Portugal
y opera en Costa Rica. Atiende a pymes de la Unión Europea y Costa Rica.

MODELO OPERATIVO:
La infraestructura digital está incluida en una suscripción mensual. Elysium
asume el coste inicial de desarrollo para que el sitio web, la infraestructura
en la nube, el software de gestión y la seguridad evolucionen con cada negocio.

ÁREAS DE ESPECIALIZACIÓN:

1. Interfaces ergonómicas adaptadas al comportamiento humano
   - Plataformas con respuesta inmediata.
   - Procesos complejos, como citas o formularios largos, convertidos en flujos
     sencillos para reducir el cansancio mental y los errores.
   - Accesibilidad y funcionamiento completo en móvil, tableta y ordenador.

2. Infraestructura digital y bases de datos en la nube
   - Infraestructura que se adapta al tráfico y mantiene alta disponibilidad.
   - Sincronización inmediata de cambios entre miembros autorizados del equipo.
   - Integración con pasarelas de pago, calendarios y otros servicios externos.

3. Sistemas de gestión (CRM) a medida
   - Software creado según las reglas del proyecto, incluyendo gestión
     financiera o facturación.
   - Automatización de procesos manuales repetitivos.
   - Datos del negocio centralizados en un panel para el personal autorizado.

4. Ciberseguridad y gobernanza
   - Estándares elevados de seguridad y cifrado.
   - Control de acceso estricto para limitar la información según cada función.
   - Cumplimiento con el RGPD, la Ley N.º 8968 de Costa Rica y la normativa local.

OPCIONES DE SUSCRIPCIÓN MOSTRADAS EN INICIO:
- Presencia: 70 EUR/mes o 700 EUR/año.
- Sistema: 99 EUR/mes o 990 EUR/año.
- Operación: 120 EUR/mes o 1.200 EUR/año.
- Mantenimiento de Hosting independiente: 99 EUR/año.
La facturación anual equivale a dos meses gratis.
Consulta https://elysiumdr.eu/es/services para el alcance y condiciones.
FRAMEWORK DE DESARROLLO λ — METODOLOGÍA CIENTÍFICA:
1. Entorno Operativo Actual — analizar flujos de datos, procesos diarios y sector.
2. Estado del Arte y Limitaciones — documentar la infraestructura existente.
3. Variables Críticas — detectar procesos manuales, manejo de datos y riesgos.
4. Definición del Problema — precisar el problema que debe resolver el sistema.
5. Impacto — mitigar riesgos y tiempos muertos y aumentar la presencia digital.
6. Arquitectura — proponer SaaS, CRM a medida o rediseño del sitio, según el caso.
7. Selección de Tecnologías — elegir seguridad, bases de datos e integraciones.
8. Diseño, Desarrollo y Base de Datos — construir el ecosistema digital.
9. QA y Auditoría — probar, validar accesos y auditar RGPD y Ley N.º 8968.
10. Entrega y Capacitación — lanzar, sincronizar datos y formar al equipo.

INVESTIGACIÓN Y DESARROLLO:
Elysium λ opera como laboratorio independiente de ingeniería de software y
consultoría informática desde la Unión Europea y Costa Rica. Combina pensamiento
científico, diseño ergonómico y experimentación continua para resolver
ineficiencias estructurales y democratizar el acceso a ingeniería de alto nivel.

Declaración de misión: democratizar el acceso a la infraestructura digital,
dotando a las pymes de ecosistemas tecnológicos accesibles que automaticen sus
procesos y garanticen su escalabilidad.

un ecosistema que evoluciona con tu negocio, garantizando máximo rendimiento,
seguridad operativa y alta retención de clientes.

PLANES DE SUSCRIPCIÓN:

1. Alojamiento — €99/año (solo infraestructura)
   - Gestión del dominio e identidad digital de marca.
   - Alojamiento web en servidores de alta disponibilidad (siempre en línea).
   - Mantenimiento y actualizaciones de infraestructura base.
   - El desarrollo de la web no está incluido.

2. Presencia — €70/mes o €700/año
   - Web, dominio, correo y alojamiento.

   - Todo lo del plan Sistema.

   - Software a medida que escala junto con el crecimiento del negocio.
   - Profesionales ilimitados. Cuatro horas de cambios al mes.

Título: Investigación — Elysium λ Development & Research

LÍNEAS DE INVESTIGACIÓN APLICADA:
Elysium λ explora la Interacción Humano-Computadora (HCI), la Ciencia de
Datos y las Infraestructuras Digitales mediante tres líneas actuales:

1. Interfaces Intuitivas
   Sistemas de gestión diseñados para reducir la carga mental de los usuarios.

2. Procesamiento de Datos
   Investigación y aplicación de arquitecturas de bases de datos para construir
   CRM precisos.

3. Seguridad y Alta Disponibilidad
   Infraestructuras en la nube con estándares de cifrado de alto nivel.

PROYECTOS DE INVESTIGACIÓN ACTIVOS:

1. Ontología para la inclusión digital y acceso a servicios en entornos rurales
   Autor: Daniel A. Morales Ávila | Año: 2026 | Estado: Estudio Piloto
   Pregunta: cómo un enfoque basado en ontologías y un recomendador de reglas
   más aprendizaje automático puede mejorar la localización y priorización de
   recursos de inclusión digital y servicios esenciales en contextos rurales,
   minimizando sesgo, exclusión y opacidad y maximizando la utilidad social.
   Objetivo: diseñar y evaluar un prototipo reproducible de knowledge graph y
   recomendación con evaluación ética y de utilidad social.
   URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/es/research/ontology-research

2. Inteligencia para PYMES Basada en Datos: Aplicación del Aprendizaje
   Automático para la Extracción de Conocimiento Operativo en Pequeñas y
   Medianas Empresas
   Autor: Daniel A. Morales Ávila | Año: 2026 | Estado: Fase de Concepto
   Preguntas actuales: umbrales mínimos de volumen y calidad de datos; qué
   métodos entre clasificación, clustering, detección de anomalías y series
   temporales producen resultados más accionables e interpretables; y cómo las
   explicaciones en lenguaje natural influyen en la confianza y adopción.
   No hay resultados publicados todavía: las secciones de resumen, metodología,
   observaciones, limitaciones y trabajo futuro están pendientes.
   URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/es/research/data-driven-sme-intelligence

--- SOBRE NOSOTROS ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/es/about

Título: Nuestro Ethos — Elysium λ Development & Research

ETHOS:
"Nuestro trabajo se guía por la convicción de que la infraestructura digital
debe ser accesible, transparente y centrada en I+D."

Misión:
Democratizar el acceso a la infraestructura digital, dotando a las pymes de
ecosistemas tecnológicos accesibles que automaticen sus procesos y garanticen
su escalabilidad. La misión es brindar a las pequeñas y medianas empresas una
infraestructura que evolucione con sus negocios.

Visión:
Ser el Elysium λ Institute of Development & Research, dedicado al estudio,
desarrollo y aplicación de infraestructuras digitales y a la formación de nuevas
generaciones de científicos y desarrolladores. Elysium λ aspira a contribuir a
una Unión Europea digital y a una Costa Rica que avanza hacia la modernidad.

NUESTRA HISTORIA:
Elysium λ fue fundada para trabajar de la mano con las pymes, impulsar su
presencia digital y darles infraestructura que les permita escalar. Las pymes
son la columna vertebral de las economías de la Unión Europea y Costa Rica,
pero muchas quedan fuera de la transformación tecnológica por barreras de coste,
complejidad y alfabetización digital. Elysium λ investiga y desarrolla
infraestructuras para hacer la tecnología avanzada más accesible, transparente
y confiable.

SIGNIFICADO DEL NOMBRE:
- Elysium proviene del griego antiguo Ἠλύσιον, vinculado con la justicia, la
  armonía y la hermandad. También remite al poema "An die Freude" (Oda a la
  Alegría) de Friedrich Schiller, incorporado por Ludwig van Beethoven a su
  Novena Sinfonía; su versión instrumental es el himno de la Unión Europea.
- λ (lambda) es la undécima letra griega y la segunda de Ἠλύσιον. En este
  proyecto representa la abstracción de ideas en sistemas ejecutables.
- Elysium λ expresa la aspiración de contribuir a una Unión Europea cada vez
  más unificada.

DIRECCIÓN Y UBICACIÓN ACTUALES:
Desde la infraestructura digital para pymes, Elysium λ pretende evolucionar
hacia la investigación y la formación de desarrolladores científicos para un
futuro digital europeo y costarricense centrado en I+D. Es una empresa europea
establecida en Portugal, con operaciones en Costa Rica, que atiende a pymes de
la Unión Europea y Costa Rica.

ENTIDADES CERTIFICADORAS Y SOCIOS INSTITUCIONALES MOSTRADOS:
ULACIT; Universidad Nacional de Costa Rica (UNA); Instituto Politécnico de
Bragança (IPB); Autoridade Tributária; Made in EU; Livro de Reclamações; Google.

--- PÁGINA INICIAL ---
URL: https://elysiumdr.eu/pt/

Título: Elysium λ Development & Research
Título principal: Infraestrutura Digital para PME: Sem Custos de Desenvolvimento

Descrição:
Infraestrutura digital por subscrição para PMEs: sistemas cloud, CRM à medida,
cibersegurança e I&D aplicada na UE e Costa Rica, sem custos de desenvolvimento.

PERFIL DA ORGANIZAÇÃO:
A Elysium λ Development & Research é uma empresa europeia de infraestrutura
digital e um laboratório independente de engenharia de software, consultoria
informática e I&D. Foi fundada em janeiro de 2026, está estabelecida em Portugal
e opera na Costa Rica. Serve PMEs da União Europeia e Costa Rica.

MODELO OPERACIONAL:
A infraestrutura digital está incluída numa subscrição mensal. A Elysium assume
o custo inicial de desenvolvimento para que o website, a infraestrutura cloud,
o software de gestão e a segurança evoluam com cada negócio.

ÁREAS DE ESPECIALIZAÇÃO:

1. Interfaces ergonómicas adaptadas ao comportamento humano
   - Plataformas com resposta imediata.
   - Processos complexos, como marcações ou formulários longos, transformados
     em fluxos simples para reduzir o cansaço mental e os erros.
   - Acessibilidade e funcionamento integral em telemóvel, tablet e computador.

2. Infraestrutura digital e bases de dados na cloud
   - Infraestrutura que se adapta ao tráfego e mantém alta disponibilidade.
   - Sincronização imediata das alterações entre membros autorizados da equipa.
   - Integração com gateways de pagamento, calendários e serviços externos.

3. Sistemas de gestão (CRM) à medida
   - Software criado segundo as regras do projeto, incluindo gestão financeira
     ou faturação.
   - Automatização de processos manuais repetitivos.
   - Dados do negócio centralizados num painel para a equipa autorizada.

4. Cibersegurança e governação
   - Padrões elevados de segurança e encriptação.
   - Controlo de acesso estrito para limitar a informação segundo cada função.
   - Conformidade com o RGPD, a Lei N.º 8968 da Costa Rica e normas locais.

OPÇÕES DE SUBSCRIÇÃO APRESENTADAS NA PÁGINA INICIAL:
- Presença: 70 EUR/mês ou 700 EUR/ano.
- Sistema: 99 EUR/mês ou 990 EUR/ano.
- Operação: 120 EUR/mês ou 1.200 EUR/ano.
- Manutenção de Alojamento independente: 99 EUR/ano.
A facturação anual equivale a dois meses grátis.
Consulte https://elysiumdr.eu/pt/services para o âmbito e as condições.
